latency_conditions.note: Dedicated passes on an otherwise idle machine, separate from the training run. The batch-8 durations are per call and are divided by the batch size; the first call is a cold start and is excluded from the mean.

dataset.licence: Dataset compilation: CC0 organisational layer. Paper rights stay with the authors under each recorded per-paper licence (metadata.license), or none recorded. No paper full text is used.
dataset.name: secemp9/arxiv-complete

latency_conditions.note: Dedicated passes on an otherwise idle machine, separate from the training run. The batch-8 durations are per call and are divided by the batch size; the first call is a cold start and is excluded from the mean.

latency_note: Batch-1 figures were measured in a separate pass because the batched pass and the batched sample could not share one loop. Base and fine-tuned are the same architecture, so any difference between them is run-to-run variation.
limitations: Labels are arXiv author-declared primary categories, not expert annotations.
The window is 2007-2009 arXiv metadata; the router is not a general 2026 topic router.
CPU-only training reached a bounded number of steps; this is not a converged full fine-tune.
Eight subject areas only, selected a priori for per-split availability.
Latency is Mac CPU batch-1 and batch-8; GPU and serving numbers are not measured.
No paper full text was used, and no model artefact is a safety or authorisation claim.
